styles.b: Handmade plasticine claymation scene, everything sculpted from smooth modelling clay with soft fingerprint texture, chunky rounded shapes, bright cheerful colours, soft studio light.

pictures.name: parrot-wait
pictures.prompt: Parrot, a cute round green parrot with a red-orange chest and a short curved beak, sitting upright and looking friendly, one wing raised a little. Single object, centred, the whole object visible with space around it, on a plain pure white background, clean empty white all around. Suitable for young children aged 5 to 7.
